theme: marker find-then-patch FINDFILELINE LASTFINDFILELINE SET DROP

tests.name: find_last_error_cs
tests.cmd: find/last error cs both early (ERROR != error)

tests.name: ghost_path
tests.cmd: find path miss OK=0 REQUIRE exit 2

weaknesses.title: FINDFILELINE empty needle hits first line (N=1 I=0)
weaknesses.detail: Empty substring matches every line; first-hit returns line 0 with success. Same polarity class as GREPLINES empty match-all; opposite COUNTINFILES empty→0. Blank ARG without agent guard patches wrong row.
weaknesses.repro: FINDFILELINE p "" → I=0 N=1 LAST=first line

weaknesses.title: FINDLINE is bag; FINDFILELINE is file path
weaknesses.detail: Dual-family trap. FINDLINE on path string does not search file content. Agents must pick FILE* ops for disk markers.

weaknesses.title: Substring only — ERR matches ERROR: late
weaknesses.detail: No whole-word/token mode. Short severity markers over-select.
weaknesses.repro: FINDFILELINE p ERR → ERROR line before ERR short

weaknesses.title: Content miss OK=1 I=-1; path miss OK=0 I=-1
weaknesses.detail: Same dual polarity as LINEAT OOB vs ghost. Must check N and OK separately.

weaknesses.title: WRITE plate omits trailing NL — HIT+IDX glue on cat -A
weaknesses.detail: HIT.txt no final $ so sequential cat looks like certs1 for TODO+idx.

weaknesses.title: SYS PUSH rejects bare numeric vars (need STR first)
weaknesses.detail: span initially failed unknown form first_i. Agents building reports must STR indices before PUSH.
weaknesses.repro: SYS PUSH bag first_i → parse fail

weaknesses.title: No atomic find-and-set / find-and-drop op
weaknesses.detail: Race if file changes between FINDFILELINE and SETFILELINE. Pattern is always two-step with IDX plate.
weaknesses.repro: find then retarget is agent glue

weaknesses.title: PRINT_JSON span bag collapses NL
weaknesses.detail: Recurring bag JSON glue on multi-line plates.

workarounds: Use FINDFILELINE not FINDLINE for disk
Prefer long markers (TODO rotate) over ERR
Check FINDFILELINE_N==1 and OK for path vs content miss
SYS STR before PUSH of numeric indices
Re-find immediately before mutate if file may change
language_gaps: Empty FINDFILELINE should miss like COUNTINFILES
issues_faced: span PUSH bare first_i parse fail — fixed with STR
